svg.title: Codex Monitor — Synthetic DEMO · Redacted
svg.desc: 251×72 terminal preview with two information columns, eight resource charts and per-core status. All data is synthetic, not measured. Chat names, models, paths, IPs, gateways, DNS, proxy endpoints and message text are redacted before rendering; original values are absent from SVG.

g.font-family: Menlo,Consolas,DejaVu Sans Mono,PingFang SC,Noto Sans Mono CJK SC,monospace
